annotations.title: Evidence for a question, each piece with its source

description: Returns cited evidence for a natural-language WoW: Forever question: observed, curated, game-file and 2023 Warcraft Wiki claims, each with source URL, licence and date. Start here for why, where or how many. Check that a claim contains the requested fact: a subject mention alone is not an answer. Observations need three agreeing installs; files stay unconfirmed with their build; archive lore may differ in Forever. If the requested fact is absent, say unrecorded rather than importing Classic or retail knowledge. For names use search_knowledge, then the hit's verified gameId with item_page, npc_page or quest_page. Further-reading URLs are search links, not fetched evidence. Disconnected observations are unrecorded, not zero.

question.description: The question, 1 to 500 characters, with names spelled as in the game.

name: answer_sources

dataAsOf.description: When the observed layer was current; null when it is not connected.

evidence.description: Answering claims first; within each group observed, curated, game files, then lore. Facts only, capped by limit.

asOf.description: When the source was read, or when the observations were current.

claim.description: One short statement. Observed facts are in Everloot's words; lore is the source's own excerpt.

kind.description: observed: players' uploads, public after three installs agree. curated: Everloot's own facts. files: the WoW: Forever game files, ids and facts only, found in game files and unconfirmed, with the build. lore: the 2023 Warcraft Wiki, which may differ in WoW: Forever.

support.description: Observed facts: how many installs reported it.

url.description: The everloot.app page for this piece, absolute: the item or NPC page, or the indexed lore page. Absent when there is none.

furtherReading.description: Search links on other sites. Nothing was fetched.

unavailable.description: No permitted answering evidence for this predicate; message points to the relevant tool. Never an evidence piece.
